name: Advance Grinding
verdict: Paid channels (Meta and Google Ads) show zero spend, leads, and clicks over the past 28 days, so all 149 GBP actions (including 3 calls, 109 directions, and 37 web clicks) are coming entirely from organic search presence. The biggest movement is a 26.92% drop in GBP engagement over the last 7 days, likely driven by reduced search demand or a dip in local ranking visibility with no paid traffic to compensate.

performance.verdict: Paid is fully dark; only GBP organic sustains, and it's fading.

findings.text: Zero paid spend across all 28 days — Meta, Google Ads, and Search Clicks all flatline at $0. No paid efficiency to measure; organic is the only active channel.
3 overdue CRM milestones predating Aug 31: 1st Directives (Jul 7), Tom call list priority (Jul 28), and dedup workbook + 126 accounts (Jul 31) — all unconfirmed completed.
342 stub reconciliation (blocker, due Aug 31) overdue — Sales-i pipeline sync is broken until fixed; 0 leads in 28 days may partly reflect this intake gap.
Web/SEO root cause fix and AGS + Forte contact pull (Outreach) both due Aug 31 and overdue — 2 blockers unresolved entering the Aug–Oct delivery window.
GBP actions fell 26.92% week-over-week; last 3 days (Aug 30–Sep 1) show 11, 0, 0 vs prior 3 (Aug 27–29) at 3, 10, 1 — weekend drop probable but two consecutive zeros warrant watching.
